description: This Java class initializes sample data for the backend API, used at application startup to seed the database with sample users, customers, billing categories, and billable hours, primarily for demo and testing purposes.
external_methods: billableHourRepository.insert(UUID, UUID, UUID, BigDecimal, String, LocalDate)

classes.name: SampleDataInitializer
classes.description: A Spring component that seeds initial sample data into the database at application startup, ensuring the system has default entries for users, customers, billing categories, and hours, with fallback logic if the database is unreachable.

methods.name: SampleDataInitializer
methods.description: Constructor injecting repository dependencies required to set up sample data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides ApplicationRunner.run to perform the seeding operation on application startup, with checks for existing data and exception handling to allow operation without a database.
